core_concept: This lesson introduces the Chrome DevTools, a critical tool for frontend developers. It demonstrates how to inspect HTML and CSS elements directly within a webpage, allowing for real-time experimentation and debugging. The focus is on utilizing the Elements and Styles panels to understand and modify styling applied to web page elements.
technical_breakdown: The Chrome DevTools provide a visual interface for inspecting HTML and CSS code.
Users can select elements on a webpage and view their corresponding HTML and CSS styles.
The Styles panel allows for real-time modification of CSS rules, providing immediate feedback on the webpage's appearance.
